::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** 20 Sept. 1889  
**From:** From <u>Dr. MURRAY</u>, (Sunnyside, Banbury Road,) <u>OXFORD</u>,  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA collection 100 box 119/9
:::

Dear Miss Yonge,

<u>[New Eng. Dictionary](other_books/otherbook_1091.qmd)</u>

Mr. [Fitzedward Hall](people/person_2388.qmd) has given me a reference for <u>Clidders</u> to <u>[Heir of Redclyffe](cmy_books/cmybook_15.qmd)</u> ch. vii., which we cannot find. Would it be possible for you to send me the quotation & with the proper reference? Literary quotations for the word are not very easily got.

We know your hand well in the [earlier Dictionary material](organizations/other_151.qmd), though it has not been my fortune to see it often in later times.

Yours very truly,
[J.A.H. Murray](people/person_1074.qmd)
